entries.reason: BoardViewSet.saved_filter_delete has no @extend_schema and always returns a bodyless 204; drf-spectacular's inferred response schema for this action expects a Content-Type, which a 204 correctly omits. #1170: reconfirmed by two full-length runs (seeds 1339052782995173070, 6600348252086321964) on 2026-10-01.

Same bodyless-204 gap as the content_type_conformance entry on this operation (id 8fe22c) — schemathesis tries to parse the empty DELETE response body as JSON against the inferred schema and fails. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

Same bodyless-204 gap as 8fe22c, bundled under response_schema_conformance as well as content_type_conformance. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

BoardViewSet.star has no @extend_schema; both its POST and DELETE branches return `Response(self.get_serializer(board).data)` (status 200) so the client can resync is_starred, but drf-spectacular's automatic inference for a DELETE action doesn't credit a 200 as a possible response. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

BoardAnalyticsMixin.analytics has no @extend_schema and returns a hand-built dict (heatmap/outlier/stalled-cards shape); drf-spectacular's generic fallback schema doesn't match it. Needs the same inline_serializer treatment CardViewSet.move/.comments/.checklist got under #1108 — not yet done. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

BoardImportExportMixin.export has no @extend_schema and answers either application/json or text/csv depending on the `format` query param; only one content type can be inferred automatically, so the other is undocumented. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

BoardAnalyticsMixin.summary has no @extend_schema and returns a hand-built dict (per-swimlane counts/velocity/cycle-time); same gap as the analytics action above (id c32635). #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

ServeMediaView is a plain authenticated file-serving APIView with no @extend_schema; the response Content-Type is whatever the served (or missing) file actually is, which can't be a fixed OpenAPI declaration. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

ThrottledPasswordResetView subclasses dj-rest-auth's PasswordResetView unmodified; drf-spectacular's introspection of the third-party dj-rest-auth serializer doesn't match its actual response shape. Not Visiban application code. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

Third-party dj-rest-auth/allauth registration resend-email view, wired via urls.py's include() (not a Visiban-authored view), with no local @extend_schema override; its real 200 response isn't declared by drf-spectacular's generic introspection of the library view. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).

WSTicketView is a plain APIView (not a ViewSet action) with no @extend_schema; it returns 201 on success (issue_ws_ticket) but drf-spectacular has no automatic schema inference for a bare APIView.post, so the real 201 isn't declared. #1170: reconfirmed on 2026-10-01 (two full runs, seeds 1339052782995173070 and 6600348252086321964).
